{{Top|leg}}
'''Galactic Rebels''' was a [[Hologame/Legends|hologame]] created during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It allowed players to take on the personae of the heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in defeating [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.
